w: The murtis of Harikrishna Maharaj in the mandir were beautifully adorned with fragrant flowers this morning. After darshan Swamishri enthusiastically blessed the 10th and 12th grade students for their coming exams by showering petals on them. He said, "Read well. You will all pass. Jay Maharaj."

After completing his puja, Swamishri was walking towards his car. When he saw R.C. Patel, an old devotee sitting in a chair, waiting for his blessings, R.C. Patel asked Swamishri, "How is your health Bapa.?" Swamishri asked him, "How are you?" "I am fine by your grace," he replied. "I am fine too by your grace," Swamishri answered.
The evening assembly was announced as 'Sacrifice Day'. The principal theme was to inspire the devotees to donate at least 1/10 or 1/5 of their earnings in the service of God every month.

A telling drama depicted this message very effectively. In his blessings, Swamishri inspired everyone to offer according to their means at least 1/10th or 1/5th of their monthly income and reserve some regular time for spiritual association and discourses.
Gems From Swamishri

When God is pleased, what does He give? Pounds? Dollars? Bungalows? No. He gives spiritual intelligence. This covers everything. With spiritual intelligence one instinctively knows how to please God and His sadhu. And when they are pleased, one gets everything.

Happiness lies in the atma. And the source of all happiness, Paramatma, resides in the atma. It is His power that is felt. Because we don’t understand this and have attachment to the body we experience misery.
By doing only what the Satpurush tells you, you’ve done everything. On his word, if you leave your worldly desires and attachments, then you will experience peace.
Many problems arise in our daily lives. Amidst them, by reciting the name of God, surrendering to Him and believing Him to be the all-doer, one will experience happiness.
People attribute fame to those who have money, power and talent. But the greatest glory of all is to surrender totally to God.
Where there is no spiritual progress, there is no peace. The more one does for God, the more peace one experiences
ph: Performing Patotsav arti, inspite of a high fever. Badalpur

w: At 10.15 a.m. Swamishri arrived in Songir village. He performed pujan and arti of murtis in the hari mandir and then addressed the satsang assembly. This was Swamishri's third visit to Songir. He had formerly visited the village in 1954 and 1976.

At 10.00 a.m., Swamishri arrived at Shri Narharibhai Amin’s School, ‘Hiramani Vidyasankul’. Swamishri, senior sadhus and dignitaries performed the foundation-stone laying ceremony of a Chhatralay for the primary and secondary students of Hiramani school. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the elite gathering during an assembly.

BAPS children sang bhajans and performed bhangra dance in Swamishri’s morning puja to mark Children’s Day. In the evening assembly balaks played two games, hot potato and musical chairs before Swamishri and the audience. Blessing the assembly, Swamishri said, “It was Yogiji Maharaj’s wish to instil values in children. By so doing they progress and attain perfection in their family, society and religion. We find that pride for one’s country, family and religion are gradually fading. The reason lies in the adverse circumstances. We have good schools and colleges but they merely give education. Formerly, in the ashrams of rishis children used to be groomed in values. Science has given us speed but not direction. Getting true direction is of prime importance. Direction means values.”

The Sat-Chit-Anand Watershow at Swaminarayan Akshardham, Gandhinagar, was ready. As part of the ritual vastu of the Sat-Chit-Anand Watershow a yagna was held at 4.00 p.m. The arrangments for the ritual yagna or vastu-homa were made by Shrutiprakash Swami and performed at the newly built amphitheatre by pundits Ghanshyambhai and Mukeshbhai. When Swamishri arrived he participated in the final rituals. Thereafter an assembly was held at the venue in the presence of devotees and volunteers. Ishwarcharan Swami explained about the components of the show and how it was created by the blessings of Swamishri. The creative director of the show, Yves Pépin, talked about how he became involved with the BAPS and the show. Mahant Swami also addressed the audience. And finally, Swamishri blessed the guests, “All those involved in the show have prepared a beautiful show. Thousands will see this show and God will bless all those who have been involved in its making.” At 7.05 p.m. Thereafter, Swamishri personally expressed his appreciations to Yves Pépin and his team (Photos in April 2010 issue, inside cover).

After his meal, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was sitting with the sadhus. Nikhilesh Swami said, "Thank you for creating such a wonderful water show here. A wonderful show has come about through your inspiration."
Swamishri said, "The great Purush who made the resolve is sitting here. He inspired it. Yogiji Maharaj inspired it, so everything has happened."
During the conversation Swamishri also said to Vishwavihari Swami, "The seating area here will turn out to be too small."

ds.t: The resolve of the great one
w: After the meal Swamishri was sitting with the sadhus. Nikhilesh Swami said, "Thank you for making such a wonderful water show here. By your inspiration a wonderful show has come about."
Swamishri said, "The great one who made the resolve is seated here. He inspired it. Yogiji Maharaj inspired it, and so it has all happened."
During the conversation Swamishri also told Vishwavihari Swami, "The seating area here will be too small."
As Mahant Swami Maharaj was climbing the ramp of Sarvasva, Gnanpurushdas Swami said, "We ask the one who does not speak to speak... so please say something."
Swamishri said, "Keep a feeling of faultlessness and divinity."
It touched everyone that even in fun, Swamishri's message, "faultlessness and divinity", remained constant. Because this is the very wish, secret and opinion of the Satpurush today.
